#0-SetupProject#
================
This file is to create a new project for the travel time project.
The example used is estimate travel time to the nearest HIV-related facility in Australia and examine its relationship with late HIV diagnoses.

```{r Initialise}
# Only requires base R

# Core folders
projects <- file.path(getwd(), "projects")

```



Copy all needed files for the model.
```{r Create project}

name <- "late_hiv_diagnosis"

# Project root and all required subfolders.
# recursive = TRUE creates parent folders as needed (works on a fresh clone).
# showWarnings = FALSE keeps it quiet and idempotent if folders already exist.
base <- file.path(projects, name)

for (sub in c("data", "data/_cache", "output", "figures")) {
  dir.create(file.path(base, sub), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

message("Project skeleton ready at: ", base)

```
